analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with Affiliates
analysis.quote: However, ESET is a company that operates globally through affiliated companies or partners as part of our sales, service and support network.

analysis.headline: Your Data May Go Abroad
analysis.quote: However, depending on your location (e.g. when using our products and/or services outside the EU) and/or the service You choose, it may be necessary to transfer your data to a country outside the EU.

analysis.headline: Profiles Your Website Activity
analysis.quote: Your activity on our website and your email address may be used to analyze or predict aspects concerning your personal preferences with respect to ESET products and services in order to provide personalized marketing messages or website content without any significant or legal consequences.

analysis.headline: Long Data Retention Periods
analysis.quote: The maximum storage period for invoicing data is determined by law and We are legally required to keep the data for a period of 10 years.

analysis.headline: Uses Your Data for Marketing
analysis.quote: Marketing is recognized in the applicable legislation as a legitimate interest, therefore We usually rely on the legitimate interest legal basis for marketing communication or the consent, if applicable.

analysis.headline: Collects Detailed Support Info
analysis.quote: Based on the channel by which You choose to contact us, We may collect your email address, phone number, license information, product details and a description of your support case.

analysis.headline: Requires ID to Exercise Rights
analysis.quote: For identification purposes, We will ask You for the following information: name, email address and – if available – license key or customer number and company affiliation.
